changelog: - **The stall warning follows the whole supply chain.** A pull all group is now also warned when what would refill its tank can never run first: an outside stage with nothing to run on, a label copying an empty Pool, an interactive Source nothing triggers, or two groups that each wait on the other. A group whose rule asks for a small first run is no longer warned when that first run fits. Help ▸ How a run rule reads a tank explains the warning.
